Subject: Urgent: press lounge ceiling panel dislodged — AV contamination & mic shortage

Morning Aisha / Lauren,

Quick heads-up from load-in: at ~08:50 one of the suspended ceiling panels above the press lounge (north-east cluster, above Stand B) partially dislodged during a rig move. It scraped along a cable bundle and kicked up dust into the AV rack area. Our techs report a small short on the AUX mixer (power tripped) and three wired handhelds show corrosion/damage from dust and light moisture (no main sprinkler activation).

What we've done so far:
- Isolated power to the affected rack and moved remaining equipment to a temporary cart.
- Shut down the north side of the press lounge as a precaution.
- Venue safety has a trades crew en route to secure the ceiling tiles and inspect rigging.
- Logged an incident ticket: INC-4521 (link below).

Immediate asks for you:
1) Confirm whether the press lounge should remain closed to media until full clearance (we recommend closure for at least 60–90m).
2) Do you have spare wired/wireless mics we can stage? Two handhelds and one beltpack would get you through the next sessions if the replacements are delayed.
3) Would you like us to expedite a portable 4G/5G hotspot while we restore house network (house fiber is fine but rack needs inspection)?

Attaching a quick photo from the rack and the incident note.

Attachment: venue-incident-report.jpg

I can stay on this thread and update as trades reports in.

— Alex Reynolds
